lessons.title: Big Korean Numbers
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 130 focus. Use the official Unit 6 lesson for the full explanation.

cards.translation: There are more than 100,000,000,000 planets in the Milky Way Galaxy
cards.explanation:
Korean uses large-number units based on ten-thousand groups, including 만, 억, 조 and larger units.

lessons.title: Saisiot in compound nouns
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 131 focus. Use the official Unit 6 lesson for the full explanation.

cards.explanation:

Use it when reading or forming the compound nouns covered by Korean orthographic and pronunciation rules.

There is no free productive suffix. Learn which compounds take ㅅ and apply the pronunciation and spelling patterns listed by HTSK.

~ㄹ/을수록 means the more or as something increases, the more another result changes.

Use it for proportional or parallel changes in degree, frequency or amount.

Attach ~ㄹ수록 after a vowel or ㄹ stem and ~을수록 after another consonant; the result clause states the corresponding change.
cards.source_sentence: 환율 변동이 생길수록 주식시장에 문제가 많이 생겨요

cards.translation: The more money people have, the greedier they are

lessons.title: There is no way with ~ㄹ/을 리가 없다
lessons.explanation: Original practice for the HTSK Lesson 133 focus. Use the official Unit 6 lesson for the full explanation.

cards.prompt: 그 사람이 지난 달에 취업하니 밥값을 ___
cards.translation: That person got a job last month, there is no way that he can’t pay for food (have enough money to put food on the plate)
cards.explanation:
~ㄹ/을 리가 없다 means there is no way that something is true or will happen.

Use it to strongly deny a possibility or say that an outcome is impossible based on reason or expectation.

Use the noun 리 with the modifier ~ㄹ/을 and add 가 없다; apply the consonant-vowel rule before 리.
cards.source_sentence: 그 사람이 지난 달에 취업하니 밥값을 못 낼 리가 없어요

cards.prompt: 드라마에서 그렇게 중요한 역할을 하는 인물이 ___
cards.translation: There is no way a character with such an important role can die in a drama
cards.explanation:

cards.translation: Samsung is sponsoring this event, so there is no way money can run out
